base_drift: Fetched origin/main is one commit ahead of HEAD; its diff contains no workflow package changes. No rebase or merge performed.
implementation: CREATE, REPLACE and GET use resolveTargetWorkspaceId: explicit ID > current UI > unique workspace_name. Missing context returns the requested no-current-workspace message. Deleted explicit/UI targets and duplicate names fail without fallback.
Agent CREATE/REPLACE/GET/REMOVE and HTTP consume tablePath.ts. TableStorageService.resolveTablePath and canvas-directory-based table addressing are removed.

extractTableIdFromRelPath accepts exact .omnimux/tables/<id>.htable and preserved .hilo references. Absolute paths, parent segments, NUL, encoded/basename disguises and arbitrary directories fail before table I/O. Workspace/table ids are validated before project lookup.
node_id/table_path disagreement returns invalid-args with the requested Chinese message. REPLACE checks node existence and table type before saveTable.

Agent L1 metadata and write responses use saveTable's returned document/contentRev. GET reports the loaded revision. HTTP PUT already uses the saved document/revision; its source and external contract are unchanged.
REMOVE validates canonical paths before graph mutation, then preserves best-effort canonical file cleanup. It does not delete legacy .hilo files.
Legacy .hilo read fallback and old array-document migration remain intact. Tests assert legacy file bytes are unchanged. GET retains the same legacy missing-revision default of zero as HTTP.

checks.note: Generated bundles remain ignored/untracked; no installed profile was changed.

environment_notes: Existing task worktree initially had no dependency links. Workflow node_modules and Hub node_modules were linked to existing primary-checkout dependency directories for read-only use; no package install, package metadata edit or dependency target write was performed.

Initial full test run reported 974 passes and 3 module-load failures: missing Hub jsdom/yaml in the isolated tree. Linking existing Hub dependencies resolved these without changing assertions or Hub source.
Package has no lint script; typechecks, boundary/tool checks, tests and diff whitespace validation were run.
scope_adjustments: REMOVE was included because D1 explicitly requires CREATE/REPLACE/GET/REMOVE parity and it was the remaining consumer of the deleted resolver.

To satisfy the 300-line code-file limit, the pre-existing 432-line agentWriteTools.ts was split: connection/execution-control tools moved unchanged to agentControlTools.ts; mutation context is shared in agentMutationContext.ts; registration imports were updated.
verification_limits: Cross-entry tests exercise real temporary files and WorkspaceStore plus route handlers; these are not L2/browser UI acceptance evidence.
No frontend source/cache changes, production profile writes, real model calls, commit, push, PR, merge or deployment were performed.
No new graph/file distributed transaction was introduced; this fix prevalidates REPLACE targets and retains the existing per-file atomic save.
